notes.title: Time to diving into dungeon for humanity. In the 2D side-scrolling game “Yusha Prototype”!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2506060/library_600x900_2x.jpg[/img] 
[h2]【About game】[/h2]

"[i] Yusha Prototype[/i] " is a side-scrolling action game where you play as a combatant with the codename "Yusha" venturing into dungeons to complete mission objectives. Use your exquisite skills to defeat monsters and bosses, acquire various loot and new techniques, and enhance your abilities to uncover the truth!
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/b15fb2d1177498e6a29a62f28d36aad877116ee6.jpg[/img]

[h2]【Game Features】[/h2]
[list]
[*] Defeat unique enemies and bosses, acquire their techniques, and become stronger!
[*] Beautifully illustrated full-screen CG
[*] Detailed and lively defeat animations
[/list]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/d6520918b95fe79abdeeea3f2d6145db0e70bc59.gif[/img]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/c2c1f28457eeb9d8422b3146699712f4e5823529.gif[/img]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41075428/e8685d4f16d229e6fc092874f2169c181acc6786.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2253970

You may also like the following:
[hr][/hr]
[h1][i] Last Monarch [/i] [/h1]

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/42396676/bfe40f2159198c7b5218008526a3a0b3187a50e6.png[/img]

[h2]【About game】 [/h2]

You are the Demon Lord Kuro on a mission to protect demonkind. Use your abilities to capture and ensnare others. Tumble with different personalities in this 2D rogue-lite shooter!

[h2]【Game Features】 [/h2]
[list]
[*] Highly replayable classic roguelike system
[*] Intense and thrilling bullet hell action gameplay
[*] Rich random events for a unique experience every time
[*] 3 captivating female protagonists  with romantic side storylines
[/list]
